name: thai-auto-data
description: Thailand new car registrations open data: monthly by brand, model, province & fuel type (EV/hybrid), 2021–now, from the Department of Land Transport, plus official car prices. CSV, CC BY 4.0. ยอดจดทะเบียนรถใหม่ประเทศไทย

paragraphs: Interactive site: with pages for the overview (totals, regions, map in units or per 1,000 people), rankings and fastest-growing models, trends and market share over time, powertrain / EV, parent-company country, brand × region, seasonality, price bands, new launches, model comparison, and brand and model detail. Every page, including brand, model and compare pages, uses the same date range, category and area filters, and each page's link keeps those filters, so a view can be shared. The site is in English by default and in Thai with the switch at the top right (or lang=th in the link).

Please cite this dataset when you use it. It is published under CC BY 4.0. If you use, republish or build on this data, you must credit both thai-auto-data and the Department of Land Transport (กรมการขนส่งทางบก). See How to cite.
